title: Kite festival pickup line
passage:
Volunteer circular | Reedbank Kite Day

Flyers can decorate their own kites, and spectators can practice with a loan kite in the small field. For the afternoon parade, the large field is reserved for kites with streamer tails. A tail does not need to match the color of its kite, but it must be long enough for the parade steward to see from the fence. When we clip a card to a kite, the large number comes first; any last letter is part of the family’s code. A dot beside the code is the drying volunteer’s reminder that the streamer is dry enough to handle.

Some families finish their kites at the craft tent before joining the parade. A volunteer held one kite over her head beside the fence and said, “You can see the tail now.” The steward answered, “That's not where I'll be looking.” During the parade, the steward stays at the far corner of the fence, and families carry their kites at waist height along the marked path. Leave the current tail in place while you find out whether it actually needs changing. [135] _____

Wet streamer tails are laid flat behind the craft tent. At pickup, a volunteer tears off the lower tab of the card and puts it in the collection tin only when the kite is handed to the family. A volunteer photographed the kites at the desk to show the next shift what was ready. In the photo the kite at the front is marked 27B; the code on the streamer attached to it also ends in B, but the folded end covers the digits. The tail’s folded tag is the one Mara recorded as 27B while she was drying it. The number on the card has a dot beside it. The tin contains a tab numbered 27, with no letter. A caller says another family must have taken 27B. The reply should make clear that [136] _____.

In the practice field, loan kites have fixed short tails and are identified by white handles. These are not parade kites. Visitors can take one for fifteen minutes. A new loan may begin once the previous return [137] _____ in the steward’s register; the queue order does not change.

If a family leaves before collecting its kite, take it inside the center at dusk. Kites still there at noon on Sunday go to the main lost-property desk with their claim tags. The Sunday time is for the volunteers moving the kites; it is not the last time the owner can claim one. A family that left its kite on Saturday writes to say it cannot come until Monday. [138] _____

志工通知｜蘆岸風箏日

放風箏的人可以自行裝飾風箏，觀眾則可以在小草地借風箏練習。下午遊行時，大草地只供裝了彩帶尾帶的風箏使用。尾帶不須和風箏同色，但必須夠長，讓遊行引導員從圍欄邊就看得到。 把卡片夾在風箏上時，大字的數字寫在前面；末尾的字母也是家庭認領代碼的一部分。代碼旁的圓點是晾尾帶的志工畫的，提醒下一班尾帶已乾到可以拿取。

有些家庭會在手作帳篷完成風箏後再加入遊行。一名志工在圍欄旁把一只風箏舉過頭，說：「現在看得到尾帶了吧。」引導員回答：「我到時候不是看那裡。」遊行時，引導員會在圍欄較遠的那一角，家人則沿著標示路線，把風箏拿在腰部高度。還沒弄清楚是不是真的需要換尾帶前，先保留這條。[135] _____

還濕的尾帶平放在手作帳篷後方。風箏交給家長時，志工才撕下卡片下方的存根，投入領件盒。一名志工拍下櫃檯上的風箏，讓下一班知道哪些已備妥。照片裡最前方的風箏標著 27B；接上的尾帶代碼也以 B 結尾，但標籤折起來遮住了數字。這張折起來的標籤，就是瑪拉晾尾帶時記為 27B 的那一張。卡片代碼旁畫著一個圓點。領件盒裡有一張 27 號的存根，沒有尾字母。有人來電說一定是別人領走了 27B。回覆時要說明，[136] _____。

練習場的借用風箏有固定的短尾帶，並以白色手把辨認。這些不是遊行風箏。訪客可以借用十五分鐘。上一次歸還[137] _____在引導員的登記簿後，即可開始下一次出借；現場排隊順序不變。

如果一家人還沒領回自家的風箏就離開，黃昏時請把風箏移到中心室內。星期日中午仍沒領走的風箏會連同認領標籤送到總失物招領處。星期日的時間是讓志工搬移風箏用的，不是物主的領取期限。有一家人星期六把風箏留在這裡，來信說要等到星期一才能來。[138] _____
